content:
I noticed that VSCode uses a version of the Lean log which fits the four latters in a grid, instead of in a line.

I tried to find an upscaled version of this version in the logos page, but I couldn't find it. Does anyone know where I could find it / if it's available for use?
May I add: also the favicon of the Lean website!

Hi @Fernando LEAL - the logo in question isn't an official Lean logo, which is why it doesn't appear on the Lean Logo Downloads page as you noted. You are welcome to make use of it. I've attached a higher res version in png and svg.


Lean stacked.svg
Thanks a ton! Was there any chance of me finding it on my own? What I did in the end was extract the favicon from the lean-lang.org website.

Fernando LEAL said:

Was there any chance of me finding it on my own?

I don't think so. :slight_smile:
Glad I asked then
Speaking of which, I' ve just noted that some folks have this beautiful Lean logo attached to .lean files, and I can't (I'm on Ubuntu 24.04), both in VSCode and in Nautilus. How can I achieve this?

I'm not 100% sure though @Marc Huisinga might have some insight. That said, I believe the logo attached to .lean files may be changing: On review, the stacked logo feels perhaps a bit busier in the file list than do comparable logos for other languages.
Yes, see #Editors & UIs > New file icons in the VSCode extension. I believe the pre-release has a newer forall logo but the release still has the square logo.

Filippo A. E. Nuccio said:

Speaking of which, I' ve just noted that some folks have this beautiful Lean logo attached to .lean files, and I can't (I'm on Ubuntu 24.04), both in VSCode and in Nautilus. How can I achieve this?

Your VS Code extension is likely out-of-date. See if you can ensure that it auto-updates so that you don't get stuck on an old version :-)
@Marc Huisinga I'm using the pre-release version 0.0.235, I don't think it is outdated, right?
That one has the forall symbol. See #Editors & UIs > New file icons in the VSCode extension @ 💬
Well, not on my laptop... :sigh:
Do you see icons for other programming languages (e.g. Python)?

Yes, for instance I've got an icon for Rocq

and also for Python
Hmm, are you using an icon theme extension by any chance?
Not that I'm aware of, now on mobile but will double check tomorrow!
(Also, the 'Workbench: Icon Theme' setting should be on 'Seti')
No icon theme I can find and the Workbench: Icon Theme is on Seti.
Sorry, no further ideas then. We're not doing anything special here, just adding the icon .svgs via VS Code's declarative configuration like all other extensions do as well.
No idea neither, I've uninstalled and reinstalled the Lean VS extension without improvement :sigh:

Found out! I had

89    "files.associations": {
"*.lean": "lean"
},

instead of lean4.
Ah. Fortunately that one is easy to fix: vscode-lean4#772
Thanks! And since we're here (and I'm an icon lover), how do I customise the background color (eg blue in light and white in dark) according to my team, if I want to change these blue/white?
I can see the "stacked" Lean logo on my end

I think the stacked LEAN logo was better over the ∀, because the ∀ looks like a folder dropdown button if you are squinting or looking at someone's screenshare (a confusion I recently experienced with a student for multiple minutes watching their screen until realizing it was the file logo)

How about making it bolder? This would make the horizontal line more visible, which will make it look less like a downward arrow.
I really like the new logo over the old one, but the forall is really really thin currently (thinner than the foralls in the text buffer with the default font)
I’d also love if the ∀ were still blue :)
Wait, I think I already sent that message…right, yes, I have :upside_down: Dedicated discussion about the new file icon at this topic
